notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Some more minor level design issues were found and resolved, mostly involving turning sprites the right way around
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Removed pressing up on a controller joystick as an option for jumping due to variable deadzones among controllers. It was causing issues with walljumping. If you relied on pressing up on the joystick to jump, I'm sorry

[*]Pressing up on a D-pad to jump still works

[*] fixed an issue with traps and certain background sprites not clearing properly when the screen scrolled passed them. This bug was most evident when playing Endless mode for a long time.

[*] fixed an issue where certain goblin dart throwers were facing the wrong direction when scrolling to the left
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Hotfix 1.0.1 removed level files from the game package causing a crash at game start. The level files have been reincluded
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed error in level 2 when transitioning from Down direction to right direction which caused two rooms to overlap in an unsolvable way.
[/list]
